annotations.title: Remove a file attached for App Review

description: Removes one App Review attachment from the App Store version being prepared, by the id ploa_details_get step review lists. While the version is with App Review, Ploa removes it once Apple has decided. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
